summary: David praises the Lord for His loving kindness and truth—He worships toward the holy temple.
meta_description: David praises the Lord for His loving kindness and truth—He worships toward the holy temple.

footnotes.note8_a: JST Ps. 138:8 The Lord will perfect me in knowledge, concerning his kingdom. I will praise thee O Lord, forever; for thou art merciful, and wilt not forsake the works of thine own hands.
